jp2a
====

jp2a is a simple JPEG to ASCII converter.

The source is available at <https://github.com/cslarsen/jp2a>. This project
used to be hosted on SourceForge.

License
-------

Copyright 2006-2016 Christian Stigen Larsen  
Distributed under the GNU General Public License v2.

You can read the full license in the file COPYING. jp2a also uses other
libraries. These licenses can be found in the file LICENSES.

Usage
-----

jp2a converts JPEG images to ASCII characters. You can specify a mixture of 
files and URLs.

**Basic usage:**

```
jp2a [options] [filename(s) | URL(s)]
```

**Common options:**

- `-` - Read JPEG image from standard input
- `--size=WIDTHxHEIGHT` - Set output dimensions
- `--width=N` - Set output width (height calculated automatically)
- `--height=N` - Set output height (width calculated automatically)
- `--chars=...` - Use specific characters for output (default: "   ...',;:clodxkO0KXNWM")
- `--invert` or `-i` - Invert output image
- `--background=light` or `--background=dark` - Set background type
- `--border` or `-b` - Frame output in a border
- `--colors` - Use ANSI color for text output and CSS color for HTML output
- `--html` - Output in XHTML 1.0 format
- `--output=FILE` - Write output to file
- `--term-fit` or `-f` - Fit image to terminal display
- `--flipx` or `-x` - Flip output horizontally
- `--flipy` or `-y` - Flip output vertically
- `--help` or `-h` - Display help
- `--version` or `-V` - Print version

Examples
--------

Convert and print a JPEG file:

```
jp2a imagefile.jpg
```

Convert with specific dimensions:

```
jp2a --size=40x20 imagefile.jpg
```

Download an image from the web and convert:

```
jp2a http://example.com/image.jpg
```

Use specific characters for output:

```
jp2a --chars=" ...ooxx@@" picture.jpg
```

Read from standard input:

```
cat image.jpg | jp2a --width=76 -
```

Use with ImageMagick to convert other image formats:

```
convert somefile.png jpg:- | jp2a - --width=80
```

Output to HTML:

```
jp2a --html --output=output.html image.jpg
```

For more detailed information, see the man page: `man jp2a`
